items.q: He got this Ligeti [Gyorgy Ligeti] person to do some incidental music.

ctx.x: Strauss. He got this Ligeti [Gyorgy Ligeti] person to do some incidental music. But they threw out North’s brilliant score.
One of the giants of film scoring and every other kind of writing, too – Alex North.
